geometry.source_dimensions: Nagasawa 2013 coupon dimensions; 36x20x5 mm, 9 mm pitch, 0.25 mm liner and medium sheets
geometry.equation: sinusoidal centerline with constant-normal-thickness sampled strip
geometry.contact_tie_assumption: perfect bond by shared nodes at isolated crest and trough contact lines; no adhesive/interphase law

materials.frame_source: analytic local flute tangent; local x=tangent, y=width, z=in-plane normal

solver.backend: implicit nonlinear Matter FEM on Apple Metal

status_diagnostics_semantics: CSV retains NMMatterStatusGPU.diagnostics x/y/z/w verbatim. On successful finalization they summarize minimum J, maximum stress, maximum residual, and maximum contact speed; a failure status replaces them with the originating failure-site float4 payload. Independent min_J and max_J are recomputed from accepted FEM positions.
evidence_boundary: native software mechanics instrument only; analytic geometry approximation and published material inputs do not establish physical validation
